title: Data Security in Large Language Models: Risks, Defense, and Directions
abstract: arXiv:2508.02312v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs), now a foundation in advancing natural language processing, power applications such as text generation, machine translation, and conversational systems. Despite their transformative potential, these models inherently rely on massive amounts of training data, often collected from diverse and uncurated sources, which exposes them to serious data security risks. Harmful or malicious data can compromise model behavior, leading to toxic outputs or hallucinations, while also creating vulnerabilities to data-driven attacks such as prompt injection and data poisoning. As LLMs continue to be integrated into critical real-world systems, understanding and addressing these data-centric security risks is imperative to safeguard user trust and system reliability. translated_title: 大语言模型中的数据安全：风险、防御与方向
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）如今已成为推动自然语言处理发展的基石，支撑着文本生成、机器翻译和对话系统等应用。尽管具有变革性潜力，这些模型本质上依赖于海量训练数据，而这些数据通常来自多样且未经筛选的来源，使其面临严重的数据安全风险。有害或恶意数据可能损害模型行为，导致有毒输出或幻觉，同时还造成模型对提示注入和数据投毒等数据驱动攻击的脆弱性。随着大语言模型不断被集成到关键的现实世界系统中，理解并应对这些以数据为中心的安全风险对于保障用户信任和系统可靠性至关重要。本综述全面概述了大语言模型面临的主要数据安全风险，并回顾了当前的防御策略，包括对抗性防御等内容。
tldr: 本文全面综述了大语言模型面临的主要数据安全风险（如有害数据、提示注入和数据投毒等攻击）并系统回顾了当前的防御策略与未来研究方向。
en_tdlr: This survey comprehensively reviews the major data security risks facing LLMs—such as harmful data, prompt injection, and data poisoning—and systematically examines current defense strategies and future research directions.
